FULL TEXT:
Advertisement
Applications are invited for the said positions under BioNEST, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
The candidate will be appointed initially for a period of 1 year or till the tenure of the project,
whichever is earlier. However, the post can be extended on the basis of evaluation after
completion of the tenure if the project is extended. The post is purely temporary and co-
terminus with the project. There shall be no financial liability on the part of the University,
after the termination of the project. The incumbent shall have no claim whatsoever for the
regularization of his/her services.
a) Name of Position: Scientific Officer
Number of positions: One
Essential Qualifications: PhD degree in any subject of Life Sciences or M. Sc. in any
subject of Life Sciences with minimum 4 years of experience or MBA with minimum 3
years of experience in project handling and/or entrepreneurship development programs and
Intellectual property skills.
Desirable Qualifications:
➢ Knowledge of Technology Transfer.
➢ Candidates having granted/filed patents.
➢ Proficiency in MS Office.
➢ Proficiency in English (both spoken as well as written).
➢ Liaising with industry or start-ups
➢ Capability of organizing Entrepreneurship development programs/ Intellectual property
programs independently.
Work Profile:
➢ Managing and maintaining the upkeep of the incubation Centre.
➢ An overall understanding of the process of bio-incubation.
➢ Enhancing the visibility of the Incubation Centre.
➢ Handling of scientific equipment and interpretation of results.
➢ Facilitating scientific liaison between incubatees, mentors & industry.
➢ Hand holding the incubatees in troubleshooting.
➢ Helping the budding entrepreneurs in developing proposals for raising funds.
Emoluments: Rs. 60,000/- (fixed) per month
b) Name of Position: Technical Analyst
Number of positions: One
Essential Qualifications:
M.Sc./ M. Tech. in any subject of Life Sciences such as Biotechnology, Microbiology,
Biochemistry, Microbial Biotechnology, Biophysics or any other related area. Preference
will be given to candidates with 3 years of experience in individual project handling,
scientific report writing and hands on experience on bioinstrumentation.
Desirable Qualifications:
❖ Individual project handling
❖ Scientific report writing
❖ Undertaking scientific and technical tasks
❖ Helping E-YUVA fellows/ innovators and scientific staff in their projects
Emoluments: - Rs. 25,000/- (fixed) per month
c) Name of Position: Helper/ Cleaner
Number of positions: One
Qualifications: 10th standard. Preference will be given to candidates having relevant
experience.
Age Limit: 45 years
Emoluments: - Rs. 15,000/- (fixed) per month
Kindly mention the post you are applying for in the subject of email. Applications (consist of
cover letter stating experience, role and contribution to the organizational goals) should reach
on or before 28 April 2023 by E-mail to bionestpu@pu.ac.in and the signed hard copy of the
same be sent by post to the undersigned.
• The candidates shortlisted for the interview (offline mode) will be informed through E-
mail or telephone.
• No TA/DA will be paid if called for interview.
Dr. Rohit Sharma
Project Leader
BioNEST
New Hospital building, Sector- 25,
Panjab University, Chandigarh
